Of course I hesitated to print the hex value of the tag, thinking it wasoften wrong, but it could have helped when the pool is trusted. I have analyze the last two coredumps: same bug (as revealed by the backtraces above) which is silly and obvious again. It arrived with my last modifications. To trigger it, a sendto() must fail after the quic_conn object has been released (and replaced by a lighter one: quic_cc_conn). In such a case, the connection is flagged as to be killed (QUIC_FL_CONN_TO_KILL). I remember having seen such connections to be killed asap in others coredumps. I hope we caught the root cause of several others crashes reported in this ticket and others.
So @participant2, the fix is here in fle-quic-bugs branch: https://github.com/haproxytech/quic-dev/commit/f3da29106671008ac6999023f0c5fd90c60ca93c
